import copy, re, runpy, subprocess
from types import SimpleNamespace
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], text=True).strip()
state_path = "docs/agent/implementation-state.json"
report_path = "docs/agent/implementation-runs/20261021T165756Z-9e3e7e80.json"
r = json.loads(Path(report_path).read_text())
after = json.loads(Path(state_path).read_text())
before = json.loads(git("show", r["startCommit"] + ":" + state_path))
choice = {"mode": "implement", "target": "I01", "findingIds": []}
api = runpy.run_path("scripts/implementation-loop.py")
assert git("rev-parse", "HEAD") == r["startCommit"]
assert git("branch", "--show-current") == "master"
assert not git("diff", "--cached", "--name-only")
assert before["authorization"] == "authorized" and before["mode"] == "active"
assert before["runner"]["model"] == "openai/gpt-6.1-sol#high"
assert "D-304" in Path(before["authorizationRecord"]).read_text()
assert api["selection"](before) == choice
api["validate_state"](after)
api["validate_transition"](before, after, choice, r)
print("PASS: clean index, exact baseline/master, explicit D-304 authorization and supplied priority")
print("PASS: driver state/transition validation (pure helpers only; no runner started)")
assert after["activeRun"] is None and after["runs"] == before["runs"] + [report_path]
for key in before:
    if key not in {"tasks", "runs"}:
        assert before[key] == after[key], key
old_tasks = {t["id"]: t for t in before["tasks"]}
tasks = {t["id"]: t for t in after["tasks"]}
children = ["I01a", "I01b", "I01c", "I01d", "I01e", "I01f"]
assert tasks["I01"]["children"] == children and tasks["I01"]["status"] == "in-progress"
assert set(tasks) - set(old_tasks) == set(children)
assert all(tasks[i] == t for i, t in old_tasks.items() if i != "I01")
for i in children:
    t = tasks[i]
    assert t["batch"] == "B1" and t["status"] == "pending"
    assert t["outcome"].strip() and t["checks"] and "dependsOn" in t
assert api["selection"](after) == {**choice, "target": "I01a"}
probe = copy.deepcopy(after)
next(t for t in probe["tasks"] if t["id"] == "I01a")["status"] = "blocked"
assert api["selection"](probe) == {**choice, "target": "I01b"}
probe = copy.deepcopy(after)
for t in probe["tasks"]:
    if t["id"] in {"I01a", "I01b"}: t["status"] = "implemented"
    if t["id"] == "I01c": t["status"] = "blocked"
assert api["selection"](probe) == {**choice, "target": "I01d"}
probe = copy.deepcopy(after)
for t in probe["tasks"]:
    if t["id"] in children: t["status"] = "implemented"
assert api["selection"](probe) == choice
print("PASS: six concrete pending same-B1 children, acyclic dependencies, safe sibling selection and parent integration before I02")
print("PASS: I02-I36, all batch review obligations/findings, authorization/runner/permissions and release gates unchanged")
for p in r["sourcePaths"]: assert Path(p).is_file(), p
for file, pattern, expected in [
    ("docs/design/03-contracts/product.md", r"^\| (P-\d{3}) \|", {f"P-{i:03}" for i in range(1,73)}),
    ("docs/design/05-verification/acceptance.md", r"^\| (T-\d{3}) \|", {f"T-{i:03}" for i in range(1,716)}),
    ("docs/design/02-experience/ui/feedback.md", r"^\| (F\d{2}) \|", {f"F{i:02}" for i in range(1,89)})]:
    actual_ids = set(re.findall(pattern, Path(file).read_text(), re.M))
    assert actual_ids == expected, (file, sorted(expected-actual_ids), sorted(actual_ids-expected))
    print(f"PASS: source inventory {file}: {len(expected)} stable IDs, assigned to I01b accounting (not executed tests)")
actual = set(git("diff", "--name-only").splitlines()) | set(git("ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard").splitlines())
assert actual == set(r["changedPaths"]), (actual, r["changedPaths"])
api["Runner"].role_paths(SimpleNamespace(state_path=Path(state_path), state_relative=state_path), before, choice, r, actual, report_path)
subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--check"], check=True)
for p in r["changedPaths"]:
    assert all(line == line.rstrip() for line in Path(p).read_text().splitlines()), p
assert r["outcome"] == "progress" and not r["findingIds"] and not r["newFindingIds"] and not r["reviewedUnitIds"]
print("PASS: exact owned changed-path set, planning role boundary, JSON/source references and whitespace")
print("RESULT: planning validation passed; no build/device/application acceptance or independent review performed")
